Information: Ph.D. Integrative, Comparative, and Marine Biology
Complete applications are reviewed for admission by the program as they are received.
Program Contact
Dr. Amanda Williard
williarda@uncw.edu
Location/Delivery Method
Main Campus
Recommendations
3 recommendation letters by individuals in professionally relevant fields.
Additional Requirements
Publications: Optional
UNCW Faculty: The applicant must secure a position in a faculty advisor’s research group in order to be admitted into the program.
Prospective students should make initial contact with the faculty with whom you wish to work Meet Our Team
Bachelors requirement: A bachelor’s degree in biology or a related discipline from an accredited U.S. college or university or its equivalent at an international institution based on a four-year program.
Resume/CV: A record of research, applied learning or relevant professional experience.
GPA Requirements: An overall graduate grade point average of at least 3.0 out of 4.0.
Notes: Under certain circumstances, a student in the M.S. biology or marine biology program may, with the support of their faculty advisor, apply to the Ph.D. program rather than completing their M.S. degree. Students who choose this path after their first year of core courses and research planning must complete a new application, including letters of recommendation, to enter the Ph.D. program.
PhD Research: Statement of Interest for Ph.D. research, including a summary of relevant experience (maximum of three pages)
